draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.33, the 35th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 5th of 37 at CB. He went 33rd overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: William Jackson III. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (88th percentile). College production: 5 passes defended in 2020, 18th of 36 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the Cleveland Browns. 72 career games and 71 starts over 5 completed seasons, plus 3 so far in 2026. Producing near his peak: 7 AV in 2025 against a career-best 7 in 2022. Strengths in 2025: passes defended 18 (99th percentile), approximate value 7 (93rd percentile), season snap share 89.1% (90th percentile). Versus the typical Year-5 cornerback who played: 89.1% season snap share against a median of 33.5%, above the norm.
